'''Operation: Hightower''' was a covert operation undertaken by [[Watcher X]] of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] on behalf of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
